name: splitr

scripts.build: npm -w @splitr/shared run build && npm -w server run build

comment:overrides: Security patches for transitive deps (SCA report). brace-expansion 2.1.4 (fixed CVE versions: the previous 2.1.2 pin was inside the vulnerable range). shell-quote/esbuild are single-major upgrades. Omitted deliberately: minimatch and fast-xml-parser (major bumps break glob@7 and the RN Android CLI), js-yaml (majors 3 and 4 have incompatible APIs, so transitive copies can't be unified without breaking consumers; dev-only risk), qs/body-parser (express 5 is a breaking upgrade), image-size/decode-uri-component (metro and react-navigation majors are breaking).
